info.title: ECHO (hand-authored) - Detailed Facility Report Demographics by ID
info.description: HAND-AUTHORED, not an EPA-published schema. Written 2026-11-02 from the behavior of the live service and from how the echo.epa.gov front end calls it. Only parameters that were exercised against the live service are listed; the service may accept or ignore others, and it can change without notice. Fills gaps in the EPA DFR schema, whose get_acsx_demographics and get_sab_acs_demographics_by_id entries are empty and whose get_acs2023x_demographics takes latitude/longitude/radius. get_acs2023x_demographics_by_id was verified: it returns ACS 2023 demographics for an FRS registry ID. get_demographics_by_id is the unversioned name used by the front end; it returned HTTP 500 for every registry ID tried on 2026-11-02, so treat it as currently failing.

get.description: Returns American Community Survey demographics around the facility with the given FRS registry ID.

parameters.description: Output format. JSON (default), JSONP, or XML.

parameters.description: JSONP callback. Name of the function in which to wrap the JSON response; used only with output=JSONP.
